selection.mainSelectionRule: Exhaustive maximum of mean prior frequency across the 10 triples contained in each 5-number combination, using only draws available before target draw.
selection.keyRule: Ancillary only: modal key among the last 200 archived draws. Key is NOT part of the triple-commonness hypothesis.

preRegisteredSuccessMetrics.primary: main-number mean hits versus matched random baseline over a prospective sequence, not one draw
secondary: settled ROI when official prize economics are available
preRegisteredSuccessMetrics.realMoneyGate: Cannot pass from the 2026-08-16 result alone, even if 5/5 occurs. Requires pre-registered prospective sequence plus economic gate.

integrity: This file must never be overwritten after creation. Settlement must be appended in a separate file.
